snippet.title: I can see the FINISH LINE for my game! | Metro Gravity Devlog 5
snippet.description:
Wishlist Metro Gravity!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2986450/Metro_Gravity/ 

In this devlog, I talk about how I'm 90% done with the game, and how I feel (somewhat) ready for the Steam Next Fest in 5 days. Also I talk about the various systems I've improved and how I've used them, for the rhythm game elements as well as the dialogue/story.

Join the discord!
https://discord.gg/RM5hktBqrv 

Other socials: https://linktr.ee/mrkogamedev

0:00 - Intro
0:50 - Content vs. Systems
1:56 - Bosses and Music
3:51 - MG Midi
5:05 - Writing
7:37 - Next Fest
8:15 - Some stuff
8:51 - Thank you
